s-04-8-correct.notes: A print piece set in points (D2-205): kicker 10 pt, title 34 pt, deck 12 pt, so check_exempt scale. B display master at 440 px tall in the surface's ink, 142 px past the right edge and 30 px past the bottom: 30.5 percent of its ink outside. The trim falls at 258 px of 400: it cuts a 116 px chord through the upper bowl (whose edge is at 273), leaves 14 px of ink beyond the lower counter's tip (244), and clears the beak (277 to 366), which sits wholly outside. The bottom trim falls 24 px below the lower counter, so no hairline of ink runs along the edge. What stays inside is one piece at every offset within 4 px, and each stroke at the trim runs over 90 px across (measured on a 1x render). The stage is the cover, so the keyline is the trim; the Illustrative label sits in the caption (CD review B2).
